description: Values for applying the frozen title/abstract criterion contracts to title, abstract, and deterministically selected Docling sections. No model-generated graph, selector, relation, or priority label may influence section selection, ordering, or reviewer input.

values.ALLOWED_EVIDENCE_FIELDS: title, abstract, year, source, document type, and deterministic Docling sections
values.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_DESCRIPTION: missing or truncated full-text evidence package
values.MISSING_EVIDENCE_RULE: A missing or visibly truncated section makes unresolved fields `unclear`.
values.CAUSAL_EVIDENCE_SCOPE: title, abstract, and supplied full-text sections
values.DESIGN_PROFILING_DEFERRAL: This routing anchor is not an exhaustive design inventory; detailed causal-evidence profiling follows eligibility screening.
values.EVIDENCE_MODE_RULES:
FULL-TEXT EVIDENCE CONTRACT

- The supplied sections are deterministic Docling chunks with stable `section_id` values.
- No model-generated selector, graph relation, or priority label was used to choose or rank the supplied sections.
- For every evidence span drawn from full text, set `source` to the exact `section_id` containing the verbatim quote.
- Prefer a more specific full-text statement when it clarifies the abstract. If supplied sections do not resolve a criterion, return `unclear`; absence from the selected package is not negative evidence.
